verdict: Maybe. Smotect pitched tablets to help people quit smoking on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. There's a huge market of people who want to quit, but health claims are strictly regulated, and some products may need drug approvals rather than a food licence.
angle: India has a very large number of smokers and tobacco users, and many want to quit. Products range from herbal tablets to nicotine replacement, which is regulated as a drug. Check which regulator covers your product before launch, and support buyers with a quitting programme, not just a pill.
